name: office-attendance-platform
description: Office Action Plan, Real-Time Attendance & Performance Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('Office-Action.apk')&&fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.copyFileSync('Office-Action.apk','frontend/dist/Office-Action.apk');fs.copyFileSync('Office-Action.apk','frontend/dist/Office-Attendance.apk');}"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('Office-Action.apk')&&fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.copyFileSync('Office-Action.apk','frontend/dist/Office-Action.apk');fs.copyFileSync('Office-Action.apk','frontend/dist/Office-Attendance.apk');}"
